additional_info.subject: ID0370382-DC/Si-D/IT[170001506] - Unable to charge parallel CRM:00315001615
additional_info.body:
Hello Olympia, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
Take 4x contactor as spare parts, as we are not sure which contactors have the feedback faulty, it's better to replace both.
Follow the 5 safety rules:
Disconnect completely
Secure agains reconnection
Verify absence of operating voltage
Carry out earthing and short-circuiting
Provide protection against adjacent live parts
For the replacement of the contactors I send in attachment the repair instructions
Please pay close attention to this last sentence, mark the copper parts before dismounting so that you can reproduce the sequence when mounting again!
If you have any more question please do not hesitate to ask :)
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0370382-DC/Si-D/IT[170001506] - Unable to charge parallel CRM:00315001615
additional_info.body:
Good morning Olympia,
My name is Sambath, I am supporting Fosco with the analysis of this issue and I will take over the ticket in the next days.
I checked and analyzed the logs of the charger, and came to the following conclusions :
On 22.07, I noticed a failed parallel charging session. However, the reason of the failure does not stand in the OGC (outgoing coil/contactor)
The reason of the interruption during parallel charging seems to rely in the converter re-grouping phase, happening when the second outlet is in cable check phase. However, we need to investigate more on this and I will involve R&D to support me.
Both outlets are charging fine when performing single charging sessions (not in parallel)
Abnormal feedbacks from the contactors DC13-14 and DC21-22 are normal to happen. I did not notice any reason why the outgoing contactors did not enable the parallel charging session.
I attach to this email a report I did of the analysis of the failed parallel charging on 22.07.
The conclusion is that, at the moment, there is no need to replace QA13-14 and QA21-22.
Fosco informed me that today you scheduled an onsite visit to replace the contactors. If possible, we could use this timeframe to perform some parallel charging tests and record more data remotely.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Sambath.K.S
